topic: Why white LED bulbs are really blue LEDs under a coating, and why the blue LED took about thirty years to make

through_line.name: the chunky blue LED
through_line.progression: the blue LED bursts out of a bulb, sits dark between red and green, is opened to show a cracked crystal, gets a clean crystal, lights up, is coated yellow and turns white
through_line.resolution: the LED sits back inside the white bulb in the ceiling lamp as in the opening view

blocks.vo_line: Your white LED bulb is secretly blue. And that blue light took scientists around thirty years to work out how to make.
blocks.through_line_state: the blue LED bursts out of a white bulb and blazes on its own
shots: CLOSE-UP, static: a white light bulb's shell pops off with a bang and flies apart, a blazing blue LED bursting out from inside
LOW ANGLE WIDE, gentle drift: the blue LED hovers under the ceiling lamp, flooding the room with blue light
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, slow push-in: the blue LED's dome pulses brighter and brighter
HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM, static: pieces of the white shell bounce and clatter onto the table
MEDIUM, static: the blue LED drops onto the table with a clunk and keeps glowing

blocks.vo_line: Red and green LEDs arrived decades earlier, but blue refused to work. How blue becomes white is coming, after the hard part.
blocks.through_line_state: the blue LED sits dark between a glowing red one and a glowing green one
shots: MEDIUM, static: a red LED snaps into a socket on the workbench and lights up, then a green one snaps in beside it and lights up
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, static: the blue LED drops into the third socket with a click and stays dark
HIGH ANGLE WIDE, gentle drift: three sockets in a row on the workbench, two glowing and the middle one dark
CLOSE-UP, slow push-in: the dark LED flickers once, sputters a puff of smoke and goes out
LOW ANGLE MEDIUM, static: the robot arm taps the dark LED twice and nothing happens

blocks.vo_line: An LED's color depends on its crystal. Blue needed gallium nitride, so hard to grow cleanly that many researchers gave up.
blocks.through_line_state: the blue LED opens to show a cracked, cloudy crystal inside
shots: EXTREME CLOSE-UP, slow push-in: the dark LED's dome lifts off with a pop, showing a small crystal chip inside
MEDIUM, static: the robot arm lifts the crystal chip up under the lamp
CLOSE-UP, static: cracks race across the crystal and it crumbles with a crunch
OVERHEAD, gentle drift: a tray of cracked cloudy crystals slides across the workbench and stops
LOW ANGLE WIDE, static: the robot arm droops and the lab lamp dims

blocks.vo_line: Then in nineteen eighty-six, researchers in Japan grew it on sapphire, over a thin buffer layer that kept the crystal clean.
blocks.through_line_state: a clean crystal grows layer by layer and the blue LED waits beside it
shots: WIDE, static: the round door of a glowing growth chamber swings shut with a clang
CLOSE-UP, static: a clear sapphire disc spins on a pedestal as a thin soft layer settles over it
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, slow push-in: a clean crystal grows upward layer by layer, sparkling
HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM, gentle drift: the finished crystal shines clear and flawless on the disc
LOW ANGLE CLOSE-UP, static: the crystal lifts off the disc and slots into the waiting LED with a snap

blocks.vo_line: The first bright blue LEDs followed in the early nineties. Three scientists later shared the Nobel Prize in Physics for it.
blocks.through_line_state: the blue LED finally lights up between the red and the green
shots: CLOSE-UP, static: the blue LED slams into the middle socket and bursts into bright blue light
WIDE, gentle drift: blue light sweeps across the whole lab, the red and green LEDs glowing on either side
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, static: the blue dome glows steady and strong
HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM, static: a shiny gold medal drops onto the workbench beside the three LEDs and spins
LOW ANGLE MEDIUM, slow push-in: the robot arm bounces up and down as the medal settles flat

blocks.vo_line: Now the secret: most white bulbs hold a blue LED under a coating that turns some light yellow, making white.
blocks.through_line_state: the blue LED gets a yellow coating and its light turns white inside the bulb
shots: MEDIUM, static: the blue LED rises off the table glowing blue
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, static: a thick yellow coating pours over the LED's dome with a splat
CLOSE-UP, slow push-in: blue light pushes through the yellow coating and comes out white
LOW ANGLE WIDE, static: the white bulb shell drops over the LED and screws shut with a twist
HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM, gentle drift: the finished bulb glows white while a blue glint shows at its heart

blocks.vo_line: LEDs give far more light per watt than old bulbs, which wasted most power as heat. So tonight, look up, because
blocks.through_line_state: the bulb with the blue LED inside screws into the ceiling lamp and lights the room
shots: CLOSE-UP, static: an old glass bulb with a glowing wire steams and fizzles out with a hiss
LOW ANGLE MEDIUM, crane up: the white LED bulb flies up toward the ceiling lamp
EXTREME CLOSE-UP, static: the bulb screws into the lamp with a click
HIGH ANGLE WIDE, static: bright white light floods the cozy room
MEDIUM, slow push-in: the bulb glows calm and white under the lamp, a faint blue shimmer inside, settling into the opening view
